title: FACTER: Fairness-Aware Conformal Thresholding and Prompt Engineering for Enabling Fair LLM-Based Recommender Systems
reasoning: The paper is focused on algorithmic fairness, a primary subfield of AI ethics. It specifically develops and evaluates a framework to detect and mitigate demographic biases (race, gender, age) in Large Language Model outputs using ethical metrics such as counterfactual fairness.
